His comments came after India were held to a draw by New Zealand in the first Test at the Basin Reserve in Wellington.

stories.title: Raghuvanshi’s show guides Mumbai to commanding win over Chhattisgarh in the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 cricket tournament
stories.summary: On his Indian Premier League (IPL) home ground, Angkrish Raghuvanshi scored a career-best 63-ball 84 not out as Mumbai cruised to a commanding nine-wicket win over Chhattisgarh in an Elite Group-D match of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 tournament at the Eden Gardens here on Sunday. Chhattisgarh, asked to bat, scored 159, which the star-studded Mumbai side achieved with seven balls to spare.

stories.title: Shubman Gill explains why 'very good friend' Mohammed Siraj was dropped for New Zealand Test
stories.summary: India Test captain Shubman Gill defended the decision to leave Mohammed Siraj out of the playing XI after the first Test against New Zealand ended in a draw on Monday. Despite opting for a four-man pace attack, India had no place for Siraj, instead fielding Jasprit Bumrah, Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj and Prasidh Krishna.

stories.title: 'Not at peak': Shubman Gill opens up on Mohammed Siraj's omission
stories.summary: India captain Shubman Gill has opened up about the decision to leave Mohammed Siraj out of the playing XI for the opening Test against New Zealand at the Basin Reserve in Wellington. Siraj's absence attracted attention, given his importance to India's pace attack. India opted for a four-man pace attack, with Jasprit Bumrah, Akash Deep, Prasidh Krishna and Anshul Kamboj making the playing XI.

stories.title: Morocco and Senegal await Afcon final verdict after court case
stories.summary: Everyone knows a football match should take 90 minutes, but the final of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations has been playing out for 10 months. Now, finally, Morocco or Senegal will be crowned winners. However, that moment of glory will come in a courtroom, not on the pitch.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: UP keen for win-win group stage finish to qualify for knockouts
stories.summary: Former champions Uttar Pradesh’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy campaign is in a decisive group stage. With three wins and two defeats from five matches, the Karan Sharma-led side are on 12 points and fourth in Elite Group A. 873 means UP need emphatic wins in their remaining two fixtures against Bengal and winless Mizoram.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant's 7 SENA hundreds, one unusual Test record that refuses to change
stories.summary: Pant's latest hundred, an unbeaten 128 against New Zealand in the opening Test in Wellington, helped him add another milestone to his already impressive Test career. Resuming the final day at 119/2, New Zealand were still 233 runs behind India's first-innings total of 702/9 declared. Mitchell remained unbeaten on 49 off 186 deliveries, while Phillips finished on 26 not out off 126 balls.

stories.summary: India entered the final day needing eight wickets to secure a historic victory. However, they managed to dismiss only three New Zealand batters before the match ended in a draw. The prospect of making inroads with the new ball offered India their best chance of turning the game around.

stories.title: 'You don't win 345 matches by defending' - Simeone breaks La Liga record
stories.summary: Atletico Madrid's 3-0 victory over Getafe may have been routine, but the win was another landmark in manager Diego Simeone's lengthy tenure at the club. Sunday's triumph at Estadio Coliseum was the Argentine's 345th La Liga win in his 567th match, surpassing the record for the most victories in the Spanish top flight.

stories.title: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland & Wales to host 2035 Women's World Cup
stories.summary: Sports editor Published 22 November 2026 Updated 7 minutes ago England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales will jointly host the 2035 Women's World Cup, Fifa has confirmed. It will be the first time a football World Cup has been held in the United Kingdom since the men's tournament in 1966.

stories.title: Poor standard of Asian teams worry India coach Marijne
stories.summary: Sjoerd Marijne stressed that he was ‘worried’ about the current level of Asian teams. Since Marijne’s return as the Indian women’s side head coach in January this year, the team has been unbeaten in the 12 matches against its Asian rivals. The results have been extremely lopsided against several opponents from the continent, barring China, Japan and South Korea.

stories.title: Rennie gets backing despite All Black defeats
stories.summary: Rugby union Correspondent Published 11 minutes ago All Blacks head coach Dave Rennie has received the unequivocal backing of his bosses at New Zealand Rugby to lead the team through to next year's World Cup. Rennie's side have suffered back-to-back defeats in the November leg of the Nations Championship and have lost five times in the calendar year for the first time since 1998.

stories.title: Shubman Gill breaks silence on dropping good friend Siraj in Wellington Test
stories.summary: India captain Shubman Gill on Monday defended the team management's decision to leave Mohammed Siraj out of the playing XI for the first Test against New Zealand in Wellington, insisting that the fast bowler's inclusion would not have changed the result. Gill admitted that informing Siraj, his good friend, about the decision was particularly difficult.

stories.title: Pakistan Announces U19 Squads For England Series; Farhan Yousaf To Lead In Both Formats After Match-Winning Fifty Against India A
stories.summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) on Monday announced its 15-member squads for the upcoming home series against England U19. Farhan Yousaf will continue as captain of Pakistan Under 19 Cricket Team. The announcement comes a day after his heroic fifty against India A which helped Pakistan Shaheens to victory against the arch-rivals.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. Photos of the wedding on Saturday show the ceremony took place by a swimming pool with the pair standing under an arch covered in white flowers. The singer's mother, Tish Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, were in attendance, Entertainment Tonight reported.

stories.title: How J&K recruitment Board’s cheating case put a spotlight on Lok Bhavan, CM office powers? | Explained
stories.summary: The J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB), the Union Territory’s main recruiting agency, on November 15 came under the scanner of the J&K Police over the alleged attempts to use unfair means by several aspirants to pass the examination in the Jammu region. 62 lakh aspirants had applied. The J&K Police has arrested 20 accused so far.

stories.title: Who is Baba Kalyani? Meet the industrialist facing a bitter family battle over ₹1 lakh crore wealth
stories.summary: WEALTH Written By Ravi Hari Published 23 Nov 2026, 06:41 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Baba Kalyani, one of India's best-known industrialists and the chairman of Bharat Forge, is at the centre of a high-profile family inheritance dispute involving ancestral assets estimated to be worth more than ₹ 1 lakh crore.

stories.title: A solo traveller’s guide to San Francisco: 6 ways to experience the city on your own
stories.summary: Planning a solo trip to San Francisco? Explore scenic parks, iconic attractions, fascinating museums, local restaurants and lively nightlife across the city. Travelling solo in San Francisco can be as exciting as a holiday with friends or family. The Californian city offers plenty for independent travellers, from scenic cycling routes and waterfront attractions to art museums, neighbourhood food spots, and live music venues.

stories.title: Prime-number puzzle & fluid equations: The two math problems claimed to be solved with AI | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Researchers said on Friday that artificial intelligence (AI) had helped them crack two problems that have defeated mathematicians for generations: the Riemann hypothesis, about prime numbers, and a central question about the Navier-Stokes equations , which describe how fluids move. Mathematicians are divided over what such proofs are worth when a computer has checked them but no person has read them in full.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. He protests that it holds only political prisoners, and asks whether there are any magistrates or judges there.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why do wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut?
stories.summary: From humidity to moisture absorption, an expert explains why wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut. A door that closes effortlessly one day may suddenly start getting stuck in its frame when the rains arrive. This common monsoon inconvenience is not necessarily a sign of poor carpentry or damaged hinges.

stories.title: What is future of gold rates? Price crash continues as AI selloff, Fed rate-hike concerns weigh on investors' sentiment
stories.summary: Gold prices continue to decline for the fifth day as the bullion witnessed its biggest weekly decline since March to multi-month low levels. US Federal Reserve’s interest rate hike, route in AI stocks spurred selling across metal markets, crude oil price volatility weighed on the investors sentiment. 32% lower at ₹ 1,21,949 per 10 gram on Friday, November 20.

stories.title: What happened to Jaylen Harrell? Police reveal alleged Uber driver assault before Titans star’s crash
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell is facing questions after a serious car accident in Tampa, Florida, left him hospitalized with major injuries. According to the Tampa Police Department, the 24-year-old allegedly assaulted his Uber driver while riding in the back seat on Friday morning, November 20. Police say the driver lost control after the reported incident, hitting another vehicle before crashing into a utility pole.

stories.title: What next after COP31: Countries return to table at UN's Bonn talks in June 2027 | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations’ mid-year climate meetings in Bonn in June 2027 are the first formal chance for governments to return to the disputes over fossil fuels and money for poorer countries that left COP31 without a deal, five months before the next summit in Ethiopia.

stories.title: Is air pollution putting India’s frontline workers at risk? | In Focus Podcast
stories.summary: With the onset of winter, air pollution levels in Indian cities have touched alarming highs once again. While discussions around air pollution often centre on soaring AQI levels, smog and measures to curb vehicular emissions, what tends to get overlooked is its disproportionate impact on the most vulnerable groups, particularly those whose jobs expose them to polluted air for prolonged periods.

stories.title: Is your breathing at risk? A pulmonologist shares signs that your COPD might be in a flare-up
stories.summary: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a progressive lung condition that makes breathing difficult due to restricted airflow in the lungs. It includes conditions such as chronic bronchitis and emphysema. One of the major challenges for people living with COPD is the occurrence of flare-ups, also known as exacerbations.

President Macron has blamed the unrest on the radical left.

stories.title: How did the COP31 climate agreement fall apart – and what happens now?
stories.summary: Two days after the COP31 global climate summit was supposed to finish, the talks in Antalya, Turkey, have come to an end – but not as we might have hoped. Agreement simply could not be reached. The sticking point was the omission of fossil fuels in draft texts.

stories.title: Karthigai Deepam row explained: What is Deepathoon dispute, and why has Tamil Nadu challenged Supreme Court order?
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government, led by Chief Minister Vijay, sought a review of the Supreme Court's one-time permission to light the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon, a disputed stone lamp pillar on Thiruparankundram Hill in Madurai, on November 24. The Commissioner of Tamil Nadu's Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department moved the Supreme Court seeking a review of the court's recent order.

stories.title: Mint Explainer | What Sakhalin-1 tax relief means for ONGC Videsh’s Russian investment
stories.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has exempted the Sakhalin-1 Unincorporated Joint Venture—involving ONGC Videsh Ltd and four foreign partners—from capital gains tax. The exemption, notified on 19 November, takes effect retrospectively from 1 April 2023. It could provide tax relief to ONGC Videsh for its investment in Russia’s Sakhalin-1 oil and gas project following a restructuring of ownership.

stories.title: The AQI paradox: Why the official count may be downplaying the pollution problem | HT Explainers
stories.summary: On November 10, two days after Diwali, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) cautioned people against trusting apps that "derive AQI from instantaneous hourly readings", because the national air quality index (AQI), it said, reflects "prolonged exposure, rather than a momentary reading". stories.title: Who has won the most women's singles titles at the Syed Modi International?

stories.title: What does the Constitution say about proroguing Parliament? | Explained

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals | Real Estate News

stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.

stories.title: Mumbai twin-tunnel project to connect Sea Link to BKC, airport Terminal 2 to Eastern Express Highway | Mumbai news
